messages:
marie: Kickoff: VoltScale marketplace listing. Need AMI/container artifacts, SKU split (Hosted API vs Dedicated), legal packaging + joint announcement copy. Quick owners?

oliver: Product preference: two SKUs (hosted + dedicated). For Dedicated, recommend hourly billing with monthly cap + 14-day trial voucher. We'll need a default model pinned for the trial flow.

kiran: Ops note: marketplace needs separate artifact bundles per cloud (AWS AMI, GCP container image + image digest, Azure managed image). Also IAM / service account examples for marketplace docs.

voltscale-ops: AMI bake kicked off. We'll have AMI IDs and container manifest within 48 hours. Sharing a sample GCP service account binding we use internally: ```yaml
- role: roles/compute.instanceAdmin.v1
  members:
    - serviceAccount:voltscale-build@volt-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

infra-sre: For Azure we'll supply a managed identity example and minimal RBAC: ```powershell
az role assignment create --assignee-object-id <id> --role "Contributor" --scope /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>
```

ana (Legal): Legal will draft EULA + addendum for joint announcement. Need explicit trademark/logo usage terms from VoltScale and confirmation on data flow (any customer data leaving their VPC?).

marie: VoltScale provided a partner blurb and logos in the drive: https://files.redwood/volt-pack.zip. VoltScale requests a co-branded badge on the listing page; legal ok with that?

ana (Legal): Co-branded badge is fine with a short brand use clause. I'll add a clause to the MSA and a small section in the listing assets doc for usage rules.

oliver: Pricing worksheet notes: list Hosted at 0.0005/token (sample) and Dedicated at $0.20/hr instance with 500 token/min baseline. We'll finalize numbers after infra cost calc.

partnerships-bot: Checklist reminder: complete asset ingest, legal artifacts, SKU mapping, and announcement calendar. Link: /doc/marketplace/onboard-v3.

marie: Meeting: tomorrow 9:30am PT to review artifacts. Pre-read: SKU spreadsheet + AMS/AMI manifest. I'll post links in #partnerships-assets.

voltscale-ops: Also confirming export control check — our hardware has a crypto accelerator; we'll attach export classification. Expect the export attestation doc in the same zip.

kiran: Action items summarized: (1) voltscale-ops -> AMI IDs, container manifest, export attestation; (2) oliver -> pricing sheet + trial model pin; (3) ana (Legal) -> EULA + co-brand clause + announcement review; (4) marie -> package listing artifacts and run preflight checklist.

marie: Thanks. Quick thumbs up if you can make the 9:30 PT slot.

oliver: +1

ana (Legal): +1

infra-sre: +1

voltscale-ops: +1

marie: Sweet. I'll share invite and drop the drive folder after this thread. :sparkles:
